description: This file defines functions for a reader object used in the BSP Run-time Execution Engine (BREE). It includes implementations for validating the reader, reading content, opening internal content, closing the reader, and retrieving the template name. It operates on a custom object structure, performing memory management and content handling.

classes.name: PBREESPO_READER_OBJECT
classes.description: A structure representing the reader object used in the BSP execution environment, containing fields such as content pointer, size, cursor, name, external source flag, and file handle.

methods.name: BOOL BreeSpoReaderValid(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Checks if the reader has valid content or is from a non-external source.

methods.name: ULONG BreeSpoReaderRead(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID pBuffer,ULONG ulSize)
methods.description: Reads content from the internal buffer into a provided buffer, updating the cursor.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BreeSpoReaderClose(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Closes the reader, freeing memory and resetting fields.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BreeSpoReaderOpenExternal(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pName)
methods.description: Stub function for opening an external content source; currently not supported.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BreeSpoReaderOpenInternal(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pName,char * pContent,ULONG ulContentLen)
methods.description: Initializes the reader with internal content and associated metadata.

methods.name: char * BreeSpoReaderGetTemplateName(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Returns the name associated with the reader object.
